name: Envirotech Vehicles, Inc.

profile.description: Envirotech Vehicles historically built electric commercial vehicles and is transitioning to AI infrastructure after the July 2, 2026 Azio AI merger. 2025 revenue was $5.9M (+218%), 94% from related-party medical supplies, with a Q1 2026 net loss of $3.99M and going-concern doubt. yfinance data was unavailable.

innovation.label: WEAK
innovation.analysis: Track Record (1/3): Pivoting from EV manufacturing to AI compute after the Azio AI merger [1]. AI Deployment (1/2): Launched a revenue-generating compute platform, no figures reported [1]. Market Share (0/2): No leadership. Pipeline (1/2): Compute platform roadmap announced, not detailed. R&D Intensity (0/1): No evidence.

inspiration.label: WEAK
inspiration.analysis: Mission Floor (1/4): Mission has changed from clean EVs to AI infrastructure. Community (0/2), Retention (0/2): Glassdoor 3.0/5 culture, CEO replaced in July 2026 [2]. Insider Buying (0/2): None found.

infrastructure.label: WEAK
infrastructure.analysis: yfinance returned no data, so only web-sourced metrics are used: revenue growth +218% (1.0), ROE negative on negative equity (0.0, 2x), profit margin deeply negative (0.0); others unavailable. Weighted 1.0 of 4 gives 2 (rounded from 2.5). Liquidity could not be verified, so the floor was not applied [1].

ai_resilience.label: HIGH RISK
ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk Protection (4/9): Newly entering AI compute with a tiny platform against hyperscalers and neoclouds; going-concern doubts and listing risk raise exposure [1]. AI Opportunity (0/1): No quantified AI revenue yet.

infinite_game.summary: Envirotech abandoned its EV manufacturing identity under financial strain and replaced its CEO, which looks more like survival than service to a Just Cause.

just_cause.analysis: Just Cause (0/3): Purpose shifted from electric vehicles to AI compute with no stable cause [1].

trusting_teams.analysis: Trusting Teams (0/2): Leadership change at merger close and 3.0/5 culture rating [2].

existential_flexibility.analysis: Existential Flexibility (1/2): A major pivot, but driven by desperation rather than cause [1].

courage_to_lead.analysis: Courage to Lead (1/2): Walked away from EV manufacturing, though under duress [1].

investment_thesis: Envirotech is repositioning from EV manufacturing to AI compute after the Azio AI merger, with 2025 revenue up 218% to $5.9M, Q1 2026 revenue of $2.25M (+281%), and a newly launched revenue-generating compute platform [1]. The Inspire score of 62 is strongly aligned.
thesis_continued: The bear case is solvency: Q1 2026 net loss was $3.99M, gross margin is negative, equity is negative with going-concern doubt, and Nasdaq listing warnings apply [1]. EV revenue was zero, 94% of 2025 revenue came from one related-party customer, and the CEO changed in July 2026 [1][2].
key_catalysts: Ramp of the AI compute platform following the Azio AI merger [1]
Diversifying revenue beyond related-party medical supplies [1]
Curing Nasdaq compliance issues via new funding [1]
key_risks: Going-concern doubt, negative equity and funding strain [1]
Customer concentration: 94% of 2025 revenue from related-party medical supplies [1]
Nasdaq listing risk and leadership turnover [1][2]
sources: Envirotech Vehicles Q1 2026 10-Q and 2025 results, StockTitan, StockAnalysis, Barchart, 2026
